kyoto_shokushu_dokoro_tsukushi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: miso-simmered mackerel and soy-based obanzai (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shokushu_dokoro_tsukushi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: marinated mackerel, funazushi and Lake Biwa fish, dashi obanzai (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shokushu_dokoro_tsukushi.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Thu–Sun 17:00–22:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday. Reservations taken; walk-ins seated when there is room (July 2025). Counter and tables full of regulars. Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Down a back alley east of Kawaramachi at Takoyakushi; you cannot see inside from the street (March 2025).
kyoto_shokushu_dokoro_tsukushi.notes: [Obanzai bar · Kawaramachi-Takoyakushi alley, a family counter for regulars] A Showa-era family obanzai bar down an alley off Kawaramachi, run by a couple with the founder still at the counter: plates of three or four obanzai, yuba, cured mackerel, a Lake Biwa set of funazushi and moroko, and local sake, among chatty regulars who welcome newcomers. Cash only. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: A husband-and-wife team with the elderly founder (January 2025 review); not named
chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2020 to 2026 describe a warm, Showa-era room full of regulars: in 2020 the owner was cooking alone; a September 2022 diner met the retired 85-year-old former owner; and a January 2025 diner found the husband-and-wife owners running it with the 91-year-old founder. A July 2025 visitor came after seeing it on a TV drinking programme.

anecdotes.text: January 2025: "The husband and wife owners, along with the 91-year-old head chef, run the place together… The healthy obanzai (small side dishes) came as 4 rather than the expected 3."
September 2022: "The atmosphere of the restaurant is a perfect example of how customers create the vibe. While there are many regulars, newcomers are warmly welcomed as well."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食酒処土筆、日本料理、中京区蛸薬師河原町東、京都河原町駅から307m、月木金土日 17:00〜22:00、火・水休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2020年11月〜2026年8月、英語): 河原町の裏路地の昭和の家庭的なおばんざいの店、常連が多いが初めてでも歓迎、夫婦と91歳の先代 (2025年1月)、85歳の引退した先代 (2022年9月)、2020年は女将がひとりで料理、本日のおばんざい3〜4品、湯葉、ポテトサラダ、しめ鯖、だし巻、銀杏、鯖の味噌煮、ごぼうの酢の物、もろこ・鮒寿司・えび豆の琵琶湖セット、サッポロラガー赤星、玉乃光、Kikko、Daiseikyo などの日本酒、テレビの酒場番組で紹介。

cultural_comfort.note: Regulars' counter; cash only.

kyoto_uru_coffee_teramachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: open sandwiches and cheesecake (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_uru_coffee_teramachi.vegan_detail: Ask: black coffee is plant-based; lattes, cheesecake and sandwiches are not described for plant milk (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_uru_coffee_teramachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 10:00–20:00. No reservations. 6 seats plus stair seating, ground floor only; open-fronted with no door, so chilly at night (March 2026); no restroom (January 2026). Dogs welcome on a lead, water provided (May 2026). English menu; take-away; wheelchair accessible. No service charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「なし」. Cards (JCB), e-money, QR. On Teramachi-Kyogoku arcade, opposite Niko and… Opened 10 December 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_uru_coffee_teramachi.notes: [Coffee stand · Teramachi-Kyogoku, a vintage shop's café] A stylish, open-fronted café on the Teramachi arcade, opened December 2025 by the vintage clothing shop HYPE: light-roast coffee from Osaka roaster ue., open sandwiches and a salted cheesecake, with dogs welcome. Only six seats and no restroom; some found it pricey and cramped (March 2026) or the Americano too acidic (July 2026).

roles: Not named in a source; run by the vintage clothing shop HYPE (December 2025 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Opened 10 December 2025 (Tabelog). December 2025 reviewers call it the café of the vintage clothing store HYPE, using beans from the Osaka specialty roaster ue.; others describe crimson tiles, an orange interior, a bonsai, a speaker blending arcade sounds and music, and a kind owner who brews well (March 2026).

anecdotes.text: March 2026: "the space inside is a bit cramped, and the prices are somewhat on the higher side."
May 2026: "I was pleasantly surprised to learn that I could let my dog down while keeping it on a leash inside. They even provided water for my dog."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: uru coffee、カフェ、中京区東側町501-10、阪急河原町駅から徒歩5分、毎日 10:00〜20:00、予約不可、6席、テラス、禁煙、英語メニュー、持ち帰り、車椅子可、原文でサービス料「なし」、カード (JCB)・電子マネー・QR可、2025年12月10日オープン。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年8月、英語): 寺町京極商店街、古着屋HYPEのカフェ、大阪・新町のスペシャルティコーヒー店 ue. の浅煎り豆、カフェラテ700円、カプチーノ、アイスアメリカーノ、オープンサンドのハーフ&ハーフ1,400円、アボカドサンド1,300円、自家製チーズケーキ700〜800円、抹茶テリーヌ、ジンジャーエール500円、階段も席に、扉がなく夜は寒い、トイレなし、犬連れ可、狭く値段が高めという声、アメリカーノが酸っぱいという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; dog-friendly; no restroom.

kyoto_taishu_sakaba_heiwa.gf_detail: Not GF: sauced and marinated meats, mentaiko karaage, garlic bean-sprout namul; strong seasonings throughout (2026 reviews).
kyoto_taishu_sakaba_heiwa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat tavern — tongue, horumon, wagyu, pig's feet (2026 reviews).
kyoto_taishu_sakaba_heiwa.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–24:00; last orders food 23:30, drinks 23:45 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised — full at 21:00 on a Saturday (Tabelog; September 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 34 seats: 5 at the counter, 29 at tables, packed close together (Tabelog; August 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; July–September 2026). No draft beer — bottled Sapporo Lager Akaboshi instead (July 2026). Off Takoyakushi east of Kawaramachi; 3 min walk from Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 1 July 2026 (Tabelog).
kyoto_taishu_sakaba_heiwa.notes: [Meat tavern · Kawaramachi-Takoyakushi] A lively new Showa-retro meat tavern run by a former sumo wrestler, per reviewers: green benches, sumo and wrestling posters, ¥299 bottles of Sapporo Akaboshi, and fresh heart and omasum sashimi, thick tongue and A5 wagyu, grilled for you. Seasonings are strong and tables tight; smoking is allowed. Book at weekends; till midnight.

roles: Owner (unnamed; a former sumo wrestler, per reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per reviews (July–September 2026): a meat tavern opened in July 2026 by an owner described as a former sumo wrestler; a July 2026 reviewer writes that the owner went independent from the Tenmaya Group and chose a "meat tavern" over a yakiniku restaurant. Tabelog gives the opening date as 1 July 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: A meat tavern rather than a yakiniku restaurant (July 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner who doubted a ¥9,999 black wagyu tomahawk could pay took a photo with the owner, who joked, "I feel like a sumo wrestler too!".
A July 2026 reviewer was surprised to find the mentaiko karaage looked like chicken-wing gyoza.
An August 2026 pair found many dishes seasoned alike and the tables close together — lively, but a lot for those who like quiet.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・焼肉・肉料理、中京区蛸薬師通河原町東入備前島町309-6、京都河原町駅から徒歩3分、毎日 17:00〜24:00 (L.O.フード23:30、ドリンク23:45)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、34席 (カウンター5、テーブル29)、喫煙可、2026年7月1日開店。口コミ (2026年7月〜9月、英語): 元力士の店主、Tenmaya Group から独立との声、昭和レトロ、緑のベンチ、プロレスや相撲のグッズ、生ビールなし、サッポロラガー赤星の瓶299円、ハツ刺し、センマイ、ユッケ、冷凍しない厚切りタン (特上・上・並)、A5和牛のロースを3枚から、黒毛和牛のトマホーク9,999円、焼いて出すか自分で焼く、明太子唐揚げ699円、豚足、キムチ、にんにくのもやしナムル、骨のスープ、大きなおにぎり、土鍋ご飯、味付けが似ている・席が近いとの声 (2026年8月)、喫煙可が残念との声 (2026年9月)、土曜21時は満席。

cultural_comfort.note: Lively and close-packed; smoking allowed; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; opened July 2026; reviews through September 2026.

kyoto_gate_hotel_lobby_lounge.gf_detail: Ask. Cocktails, wine, whisky and Kyoto craft gin; snacks such as raw chocolate, fries and Kyoto pickles; a clubhouse sandwich; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gate_hotel_lobby_lounge.vegan_detail: Ask. Drinks and light snacks; no ingredient information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gate_hotel_lobby_lounge.hours_raw: Daily 6:30–22:30 per Tabelog; irregular closing days; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR; non-smoking (Tabelog). Counter, sofas and a terrace on the top floor of the hotel, with views of Higashiyama, the Kamo River and Minami-za (2025–2026 reviews). In the former Rissei Elementary School (1928), now Rissei Garden HULIC Kyoto, off Takoyakushi east of Kawaramachi; 3 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; April 2026).
kyoto_gate_hotel_lobby_lounge.notes: [Hotel lounge · Kawaramachi, top-floor views] The lobby lounge and bar on the top floor of THE GATE HOTEL Kyoto Takasegawa, in a converted 1928 school: sink into a sofa or the terrace for wide views over Higashiyama, the Kamo River and Minami-za, with Kyoto craft gin, cocktails, wine or an afternoon coffee and clubhouse sandwich. Quiet by day, reasonable for a hotel. Open from early morning to 22:30.

chef_bio.background: Per the hotel site and reviews: the lobby lounge and bar of THE GATE HOTEL Kyoto Takasegawa by HULIC, on the top floor of a building in the redeveloped former Kyoto City Rissei Elementary School (completed 1928, per an April 2026 reviewer), with a separate hotel restaurant alongside.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto craft gin; views of Higashiyama.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 reviewer on a tour of retro buildings noted the former Rissei Elementary School, completed in 1928, and the lounge's selection of Kyoto craft gin.
An August 2026 visitor sent from the fully booked restaurant to the lounge found it nearly empty and quiet on a Sunday afternoon.
A July 2026 guest stopped after dinner for Yamazaki on the rocks with the night view of Higashiyama.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バー、中京区蛸薬師通河原町東入備前島町310-2 ゲートホテルKYOTO、阪急四条河原町から294m、毎日 6:30〜22:30、不定休、営業時間は変わることあり、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、禁煙、景色・夜景がよい。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年9月、英語): 旧 Rissei 小学校 (1928年) を生かした Rissei Garden HULIC Kyoto のホテル最上階、東山・鴨川・南座の眺め、ソファ、テラス、カウンター、カクテル (Viva La Vida)、京都のクラフトジン、ワイン、ウイスキー (Yamazaki)、生チョコ、フライドポテト、京漬物、クラブハウスサンド、昼は静か、ホテルの値段としては手ごろ。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel lounge; cards, IC and QR; non-smoking.

kyoto_kogara_shokudo_yoru_sakaba.gf_detail: Not GF: breaded tonkatsu and karaage (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kogara_shokudo_yoru_sakaba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork cutlet and fried chicken set meals, served with bonito and kombu dashi (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kogara_shokudo_yoru_sakaba.hours_raw: Lunch daily 11:00–14:30; dinner 17:30–21:30, to 22:00 on Thursday and Saturday (Tabelog); the opening press release gave dinner to 22:30 on Friday, Saturday and holiday eves — hours may change (Tabelog; press release). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cashless only — cards, e-money, QR and Apple Pay; no cash (Tabelog). Counter and about two tables; non-smoking; self-service water; order by QR code (Tabelog; December 2025 and March 2026). Down a passage beside an apartment building, near ja!rêve, on Kawaramachi south of Bukkoji; 4 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; December 2025). Opened 24 December 2025 (Tabelog; press release).
kyoto_kogara_shokudo_yoru_sakaba.notes: [Tonkatsu · Kawaramachi-Bukkoji, hidden down a passage] A small new set-meal shop tucked behind an apartment block, serving pink, low-temperature rosé tonkatsu with salt or a pour of dashi instead of sauce, plus crisp karaage with Kujo negi, over a white-and-brown rice blend — from ¥1,380 at lunch, with drinks at night. Cashless only.

chef_bio.background: Per the opening press release: run by 株式会社UEiQ, a restaurant operator whose fire control was honed making chashu for ramen; opened 24 December 2025 as a set-meal shop for locals by day and a tavern by night; the name comes from 小柄 (こがら, compact, small box) and a wish to stay humble. December 2025 reviewers say UEiQ opened several Kyoto restaurants that year.
chef_bio.philosophy: Compact and humble — 小柄 (press release).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 visitor ran into a manager recognised from another of the operator's restaurants, and preferred the crisp karaage to the tonkatsu.
A February 2026 diner ordered the smallest 150 g Kuro Kirishima Sanroku cutlet and was startled by its size, and by being told to eat it with dashi.
A March 2026 weekday-lunch guest found the place empty after 13:00, ordered by QR code and had the set in about seven minutes.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: とんかつ、下京区河原町通仏光寺下ル富永町354、阪急河原町駅から徒歩4分、昼 毎日 11:00〜14:30、夜 17:30〜21:30 (木・土は22:00まで)、予約可、現金不可 (カード・電子マネー・QR・Apple Pay)、禁煙、カウンター、2025年12月24日開店。プレスリリース: 株式会社UEiQ、ラーメンのチャーシュー作りで培った火入れ、昼は定食屋・夜は酒場、ロゼとんかつ御膳1,380円、からあげ御膳 (5個、九条ねぎだれ) 1,430円、店名は「小柄 (こがら) ＝小箱・コンパクト」と謙虚さから。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年3月、英語): マンションの奥の通路、赤ワインに漬けて低温で揚げたロゼとんかつ、塩・柚子おろし・かつおと昆布のだしで、Kuro Kirishima Sanroku の豚150g 1,980円・300g 2,550円、合い盛り1,480円、温玉のロゼかつ丼、白米と玄米のブレンド、キャベツ、冷奴、漬物、味噌汁、水はセルフ、QR注文。

cultural_comfort.note: QR ordering; cashless only; self-service water.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and opening press release; reviews through March 2026.

kyoto_gion_manju_shijo.gf_detail: Ask. Rice-flour sweets such as shinko and minazuki, mochi and warabi mochi; no ingredient or gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_manju_shijo.vegan_detail: Ask. Rice flour, red bean, kinako and sugar sweets look plant-based, but no ingredient information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_manju_shijo.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–17:30; hours may change (Tabelog). Takeaway only — no seating (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Seasonal items sell out, e.g. matcha minazuki and matcha shinko (June and September 2026). On Shijo-dori right next to Minami-za, by Keihan Gion-Shijo Stn exit 6 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_manju_shijo.notes: [Wagashi · Shijo beside Minami-za, takeaway] A long-established sweets shop next to the Minami-za theatre, popular with theatregoers at the interval: chewy cinnamon shinko, summer minazuki in three flavours, kashiwa mochi with miso bean paste and generously dusted warabi mochi, from about ¥190. One June 2026 buyer found the white minazuki a little too sweet. Takeaway only; cash.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews (2025–2026): a traditional wagashi shop next to Minami-za on Shijo-dori; a July 2026 reviewer gives its founding as 1819 (Bunsei 2). Known for shinko and monthly seasonal sweets.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 mother and daughter dropped in during the interval of a Minami-za performance for shinko at ¥190.
A June 2026 theatregoer found the matcha minazuki sold out and the white one a little too sweet.
A May 2026 regular buys the seasonal sweets on every Kawaramachi visit, and favours the kashiwa mochi with miso bean paste.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 和菓子、東山区四条通大和大路西入ル、京阪祇園四条駅6番出口すぐ、毎日 10:00〜17:30、営業時間は変わることあり、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、イートインなし、テイクアウト。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年10月、英語): 南座の隣、1819年 (文政2年) 創業との声、しんこ190円 (にっき・白・抹茶)、水無月230円 (白・Hateruma の黒糖・宇治抹茶)、柏餅250円 (味噌あん・こしあん)、笹餅230円、わらび餅、栗蒸し羊羹、抹茶は売り切れのことも、白の水無月は少し甘すぎたとの声 (2026年6月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway counter; cash only.

kyoto_okeya_kyujiro.gf_detail: Ask. A set omakase of sushi, tempura, shabu-shabu and soba (May 2026); tempura and soba usually contain wheat. Tell the restaurant about allergies when booking (Tabelog).
kyoto_okeya_kyujiro.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood omakase of sushi, tempura and shabu-shabu (May 2026).
kyoto_okeya_kyujiro.hours_raw: Wed–Sat: lunch "Ochakase" afternoon tea 11:30–15:30, dinner 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday to Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservation only, online, with a credit card; cancel at least 48 hours ahead; groups of 5 or more pay in full in advance (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料10％」). Cards incl. UnionPay; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 12 counter seats (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Hard to find — staff meet guests at the entrance at the booked time (April 2026). Off Nishikiyamachi north of Shijo, 3 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi and Gion-Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_okeya_kyujiro.notes: [Theatrical omakase · Nishikiyamachi, sushi as a stage show] A 12-seat counter where a curtain rises on a two-hour staged omakase — sushi, tempura, shabu-shabu, soba and matcha, with bamboo-leaf carving and lantern light — from a group whose Montreal, Vancouver and Toronto restaurants have Michelin recognition. Lunch is a hands-on matcha and wagashi afternoon tea. English-speaking staff. Wed–Sat, booking online only; 10% service charge.

roles: Founder Matsuda (given name not in the sources), from Mie Prefecture (May 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a sensory dining experience from a chef behind a Michelin one-star restaurant, with a theatre-style omakase dinner and an "Ochakase" afternoon tea. A May 2026 review says the group was founded by Matsuda, from Mie, and opened in Montreal in 2020 (featured in Quebec's first Michelin selection in 2025), Vancouver in 2022 (one Michelin star within a year) and Toronto in 2024 (Michelin-listed in its first year), before Kyoto.
chef_bio.philosophy: Food, sound, aroma and performance combined into one experience (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner describes staff in traditional dress leading guests into a lantern-lit room, then a black curtain rising a minute after sitting down.
A May 2026 host who usually interprets for overseas guests found every staff member spoke English and knew the details.
An October 2026 diner found the food better than expected — and the bill high.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司・日本料理、中京区西木屋町通四条上る紙屋町367、阪急京都河原町駅・京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩約3分、水〜土11:30〜15:30と17:00〜22:00、日月火休み、完全予約制 (オンライン、カード必須、48時間前までのキャンセル、5名以上は前払いとサービス料20%)、サービス料10%、カウンター12席、禁煙、ミシュラン一つ星の店を手がけたシェフ、劇場型のおまかせディナー、昼は「Ochakase」のアフタヌーンティー。口コミ (2026年4月〜10月、英語): 創業者は三重出身の Matsuda、モントリオール (2020年)、バンクーバー (2022年)、トロント (2024年)、寿司、天ぷら、しゃぶしゃぶ、そば、抹茶、sasagiri の実演、和菓子作り、英語が通じる。複数の口コミ (2026年4月・5月) で海外からの客が多いとある。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff speak English (May 2026); book online with a card; arrive on time — staff meet guests at the entrance. Several reviews (April and May 2026) say most guests come from overseas.

kyoto_kyo_no_sakana_katsugi.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–22:30 (last order food 21:00, drinks 21:30; courses to 21:00); closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; 50% cancellation fee the day before, 100% on the day; call ahead to bring children or pets (Tabelog). Table charge ¥1,100 when ordering à la carte (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「アラカルトの場合：席料1100円」). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 22 seats, mostly private rooms, on the second floor of a building (Tabelog; November 2023; January 2026). On Kiyamachi north of Shijo, 2 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyo_no_sakana_katsugi.notes: [Fish kaiseki · Kiyamachi, private rooms (dogs welcome)] A second-floor fish restaurant on Kiyamachi, named after Kyoto's old fish carriers, serving seasonal sashimi, grilled fish and ankake dishes as courses in private rooms, with Kyoto sake. Well suited to business dinners and groups — and dogs can join in a private room by arrangement. ¥1,100 table charge à la carte.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Japanese restaurant on Kiyamachi whose name, Katsugi, comes from the fishmongers who once carried live fish into Kyoto; seasonal dishes with fine fish and mainly Kyoto sake, in private rooms; pets welcome with notice.

anecdotes.text: A July 2024 visitor brought a dog to a private room and was grateful for the air conditioning and the help charging a phone.
A March 2024 host chose it for a Muslim friend who does not eat pork, because the menu centres on fish.
A December 2024 family gathering found the dishes excellent but the pacing slow — three and a half hours to dessert.

kyoto_18_premier_bar.gf_detail: Ask. A drinks bar — beer, highballs, cocktails, wine, shochu (2025 reviews); beer contains gluten; no food information.
kyoto_18_premier_bar.vegan_detail: Ask. Drinks only in the sources (2025 reviews).
kyoto_18_premier_bar.hours_raw: 21:00–5:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog; May 2025). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). All-you-can-drink pricing differs by gender and for students, per May–June 2025 reviews: men from ¥3,500, women from ¥2,500 (women ¥1,000 for one hour), students ¥2,000 with ID; a two-hour limit on Fridays, weekends and holidays (May 2025). Darts, karaoke rooms and a VIP room with a ¥5,000 charge (May and June 2025). Yaei Building Kiyamachi 3F, north of Shijo, 2 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi (Tabelog; May 2025).
kyoto_18_premier_bar.notes: [Bar · Kiyamachi, all-you-can-drink until 5 am] A neon-lit third-floor bar off Kiyamachi with graffiti walls, darts, karaoke rooms and a VIP room, built around cheap free-time all-you-can-drink — priced differently for men, women and students — and open until 5:00. Smoking allowed. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a bar on the third floor of the Yaei Building on Kiyamachi, open late. Reviews in 2025 describe neon and graffiti decor, darts, karaoke rooms and a VIP room.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 visitor brought friends from abroad here for an after-party following a day of sightseeing.
A June 2025 pair, mindful of the last train, had one drink each under the wall-to-wall graffiti.
A June 2025 visitor returning to Kiyamachi after fifteen years found the street transformed, and ended the night here.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バー、中京区鍋屋町217 弥栄ビル木屋町 3F、21:00〜翌5:00、火曜休み、予約可、カード可、喫煙可。口コミ (2025年4月〜8月、英語): ネオンとグラフィティの内装、ダーツ、カラオケの部屋、VIP ルーム (チャージ5,000円、オリジナルのシャンパン)、時間無制限の飲み放題は男性3,500円から、女性2,500円から、女性1時間1,000円、学生2,000円、金土日祝は2時間制、ハイボール、カクテル、ワイン、焼酎。

cultural_comfort.note: Ask for the all-you-can-drink plan; smoking allowed; open very late. No English evidence found.

kyoto_yakiniku_ryu_kawaramachi.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled wagyu with sauces, plus chijimi, kimchi and namul (September–October 2026); no gluten information.
kyoto_yakiniku_ryu_kawaramachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku restaurant (2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_ryu_kawaramachi.hours_raw: Daily 16:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); open all year (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; bookings more than 15 minutes late without notice are cancelled (Tabelog). Year-end surcharge of 10% in December and to 5 January (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「※12/4.5.11〜1/5まで年末年始料金として10％頂いてます」). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 51 seats over two floors (5F and 6F) with sofa seating and a terrace (Tabelog; October 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Kawaramachi north of Shijo, 2 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi (Tabelog; September 2026). Opened 9 December 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_yakiniku_ryu_kawaramachi.notes: [Wagyu yakiniku · Kawaramachi, tongue and skirt] A two-floor yakiniku above Kawaramachi specialising in A5 black wagyu tongue and skirt, best known for the ¥4,500 "Hakuryu" all-you-can-eat course of some 95 items, from tongue sashimi and yukhoe to kalbi and loin. Open daily from 16:00; 10% surcharge over the New Year period.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a yakiniku restaurant specialising in black wagyu tongue and skirt, opened in December 2024 on the fifth and sixth floors of a Kawaramachi building; a sister shop is in Namba Sennichimae.
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu tongue and skirt; all-you-can-eat course.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner, driving afterwards, appreciated the ¥500 soft-drink free flow with the Hakuryu course.
An October 2026 visitor named the "revolutionary" skirt the best of the course.
An October 2026 pair arriving late on a rainy night found the floor nearly empty and had most orders within five minutes.

kyoto_izakaya_suzume_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Home-style izakaya food — oden, dashimaki, sashimi, yakitori with sansho, fried dishes, curry; no gluten information (2012–2025 reviews).
kyoto_izakaya_suzume_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden in dashi, yakitori, sashimi and fried dishes (2012–2025 reviews).
kyoto_izakaya_suzume_pontocho.hours_raw: Monday–Wednesday and Friday–Sunday 16:15–22:00; Thursday 17:00–22:00; open on New Year's Eve (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). An appetizer charge of about ¥500, with the bill rounded up (April 2014). 14 seats: 6 at the counter, 2 tables for 4; non-smoking (Tabelog). Down Pontocho's alley 15 north of Shijo, marked only by a red lantern; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo, Kawaramachi and Sanjo Stns (Tabelog; November 2024). Opened 2 March 1985 (Tabelog).
kyoto_izakaya_suzume_pontocho.notes: [Izakaya · Pontocho alley 15, since 1985] A tiny red-lantern izakaya down one of Pontocho's numbered alleys, run since 1985 and now by the second generation: home-style oden, dashimaki and yakitori with sansho, sake, and above all a chatty host and plenty of Pontocho stories. Opens at 16:15 for early drinks. Cash only; small appetizer charge.

roles: Owners (unnamed): a talkative host and a partner in the kitchen; second generation since July 2022
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya opened 2 March 1985; from July 2022 the second-generation proprietress has carried on the business. Reviewers describe a husband-and-wife team, the host chatting and the partner cooking (2012–2018, September 2025), and in November 2024 sister owners full of stories.

anecdotes.text: An April 2014 visitor found the owner alone that day and heard non-stop talk of yamauni tofu, horse racing and sushi — but thought the ¥500 appetizer and rounded-up bill a bit pricey.
A September 2023 guest heard many stories about Pontocho, including advice on why some places turn first-timers away.
A November 2024 party, booked ahead, squeezed in at 20:55 on a full night for a draft beer and the menu of seafood and home cooking.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋、中京区先斗町四条上がる15番ろうじ、阪急河原町駅・京阪三条駅・祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月〜水・金〜日 16:15〜22:00、木 17:00〜22:00、大晦日も営業、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、14席 (カウンター6、4人がけテーブル2)、禁煙、1985年3月2日開店、2022年7月から2代目の女将が引き継いで営業再開。口コミ (2012年10月〜2025年9月、英語): 赤ちょうちんだけが目印の路地の店、話好きな主人と料理担当の連れ合い、2024年11月は姉妹の店主とも、壁の短冊のメニュー、おでん、だし巻き、刺身、焼き魚、山椒の赤鶏の焼鳥、yamauni 豆腐、揚げ物、カレー、日本酒、焼酎、生ビール、お通しは500円ほどで会計は切り上げ、やや高いとの声 (2014年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Tiny counter bar with chatty hosts; cash only.

kyoto_enamiya_saku_no_ma.gf_detail: Not GF: okonomiyaki, omusoba with yakisoba noodles, tonpei-yaki with sauce (2017–2024 reviews).
kyoto_enamiya_saku_no_ma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg and pork teppan dishes, corned beef, kabuto miso (2017–2024 reviews).
kyoto_enamiya_saku_no_ma.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday–Sunday 19:00–5:00, last order 3:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). 16 seats, counter and tables, upstairs in a small alley building; smoking allowed (Tabelog; June 2022). Down alley 13 between Kiyamachi and Pontocho, east off Teruya-koji (Tabelog; April 2018). Website sakunoma.com (Tabelog).
kyoto_enamiya_saku_no_ma.notes: [Teppan bar · alley 13 off Kiyamachi, till 5 a.m.] A snug upstairs bar hidden in a numbered alley between Kiyamachi and Pontocho, where regulars and late-shift locals come for omusoba, tonpei-yaki and tonjiru after midnight, with Shuhari and Kenbishi sake and a homemade ginger sour. A friendly master and a rock soundtrack. Smoking allowed; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a late-night dining bar in alley 13, with a website at sakunoma.com. A March 2019 reviewer writes that the owner is the vocalist of a legendary Kyoto band; an April 2018 reviewer that the president of Matsumoto Brewery worked there part-time as a student. Reviewers describe a warm master and many regulars (2024).

anecdotes.text: An April 2018 reviewer calls it the spot where the president of Matsumoto Brewery once worked part-time as a student — and it pours that brewery's Shuhari.
A March 2019 regular says the owner is the vocalist of a legendary Kyoto band, which shows in the music, and that industry people gather after midnight.
A May 2026 regular of four visits looks forward each year to the homemade ginger sour.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイニングバー、中京区木屋町てるや小路東入ル13番路地、月・水〜日 19:00〜翌5:00 (L.O.3:00)、火曜休み、営業時間は変わることあり、予約可、16席、喫煙可、公式サイト sakunoma.com。口コミ (2017年11月〜2026年5月、英語): 木屋町と先斗町の間の13番路地、小さな飲食ビルの2階、オムそば、とん平焼き、卵とかつお節たっぷりのお好み焼き、honmoku-yaki、コンビーフ、板わさ、かぶと味噌、ミックスナッツ、豚汁、粕汁、大きなおにぎり、Matsumoto Shuzo の Shuhari、Kenbishi の燗、自家製のはじかみのジンジャーサワー、ロックのポスター、店主は京都の伝説的なバンドのボーカルとの声 (2019年3月)、Matsumoto Shuzo の社長が学生時代にアルバイトをしていたとの声 (2018年4月)、常連が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Small regulars' bar; open very late; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and website; latest review May 2026.

kyoto_siesta_burrito_fuyacho.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat-tortilla burritos and wraps, some freshly fried (2026 reviews).
kyoto_siesta_burrito_fuyacho.vegan_detail: Ask. Burritos are packed with vegetables, beans and rice, and the menu lists every ingredient, but the classic has chicken; no vegan option confirmed (2026 reviews).
kyoto_siesta_burrito_fuyacho.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–21:00, last order 20:50 (Tabelog). Queues at lunch and weekends — 40–50 minutes on a July 2026 holiday — but walk-ins in the evening (July–September 2026). Order and pay first, then sit; takeaway popular; a burrito can be cut in half (July–September 2026). Payment methods not listed on Tabelog. A small shop in an old house off Kawaramachi, on Fuyacho south of Ayanokoji (Tabelog; August 2026). Opened 22 November 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_siesta_burrito_fuyacho.notes: [Burritos · Fuyacho off Kawaramachi] A small, upbeat burrito and taco shop in an old house: huge, chewy-tortilla burritos stuffed with vegetables, chicken, beans and rice — the ¥1,100 Classic is the favourite — plus wraps, tacos and a kids taco rice. Order and pay first; expect a queue at lunch. Staff lent ice packs and umbrellas to the summer line.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a taco shop opened 22 November 2024 on Fuyacho. Reviewers in 2026 describe a lively, relaxed staff, a menu listing every ingredient, and many takeaway orders.

anecdotes.text: In July 2026 staff lent a towel-wrapped ice pack to a parent queuing 40–50 minutes in the sun with a two-year-old, and umbrellas to others in line.
An August 2026 diner noticed a pedal-operated hand-washing station.
A September 2026 visitor found the ¥1,100 Classic so good it went down like a drink.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: タコス、下京区麩屋町通綾小路下る俵屋町309-1、京都河原町駅から313m、毎日 11:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:50)、2024年11月22日開店。口コミ (2026年7月〜10月、英語): 古い家の外観でおしゃれな店内、昼と週末は行列 (祝日の昼に40〜50分)、夜は待たずに入れる、先に注文と支払い、テイクアウトが多い、野菜・鶏肉・豆・ご飯たっぷりの大きなブリトー、クラシック1,100円、半分に切ってもらえる、サルサで味変、ラップサンド、タコス、ドリンクやメキシカンポテトのセット、子ども用のタコライス、ビール、材料がすべて書かれたメニュー、並ぶ客に保冷剤や日傘を貸してくれた (2026年7月)、足踏み式の手洗い。

cultural_comfort.note: Order and pay at the counter; ingredients listed on the menu; takeaway.

kyoto_thai_kitchen_baramee.gf_detail: Ask. Rice dishes and rice-noodle pad thai, but fish sauce, soy-based seasonings, fried spring rolls and curries; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_thai_kitchen_baramee.vegan_detail: Ask. Coriander salad and adjustable dishes, but fish sauce and shrimp are common; staff changed a dressing and the spice level on request (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_thai_kitchen_baramee.hours_raw: Lunch Tuesday–Sunday 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00). Dinner: Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday and the day after a holiday 18:00–24:00; Thursday 18:00–23:00; Saturday and the day before a holiday 17:00–24:00; Sunday and holidays 17:00–23:00 (last orders 22:00–23:00). Closed Monday (Tuesday if Monday is a holiday); no lunch 1–3 January (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; groups of five or more are split into tables of four; everyone orders a drink at dinner (Tabelog). 1F of the RINSEN AVENUE building on Kiyamachi; 3 min walk from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 22 June 2018 (Tabelog).
kyoto_thai_kitchen_baramee.notes: [Thai · Kiyamachi north of Shijo] A lively Thai kitchen on Kiyamachi with a Thai chef, per a reviewer: pad thai and gapao lunch sets for ¥1,180 (free large pad thai), and at night tom yum goong, soft-shell crab curry, shrimp spring rolls and Thai hotpot, with courses and all-you-can-drink. Spice can be dialled down — or up. One July 2026 diner found it average. Closed Monday.

roles: Thai chef (unnamed, per a June 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Thai restaurant, izakaya and dining bar opened 22 June 2018 on Kiyamachi. A June 2026 reviewer credits a Thai chef; reviewers describe friendly staff who adjust spice and dressings on request (2025–2026).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner worried about heat had the gapao rice made without spice and the salad dressing changed.
A January 2026 lunch guest chose the middle of three spice levels for the green curry and found it very hot.
A July 2026 diner found the pad thai just okay — a place for first-timers to Thai food.

kyoto_2254_lounge_miyagawacho.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: cheesecake, Neapolitan spaghetti and craft beer (2020–2026 reviews).
kyoto_2254_lounge_miyagawacho.vegan_detail: Ask: black coffee and organic smoothies may suit; cakes and milk drinks do not (2020–2026 reviews).
kyoto_2254_lounge_miyagawacho.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sun 10:00–20:00; closed Monday and some other days, and hours vary — check Instagram. No reservations. 14 seats with a terrace. Non-smoking except by the entrance. Pets welcome on a lead, any size; bring your own pet food (Tabelog). English menu; children and strollers welcome; wheelchair access; Wi-Fi and power outlets. Cards, transit IC and e-money, PayPay. A brick townhouse in Miyagawa-cho that is also the lounge of a whole-building rental hotel, open to all. Opened 14 July 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_2254_lounge_miyagawacho.notes: [Café-bar · Miyagawa-cho, a hotel lounge open to all] A quiet brick-front café-bar on Miyagawa-cho that doubles as the lounge of a whole-building rental hotel: specialty coffee, craft beer, a salted cheesecake and a green view, with dogs of any size welcome. Hours vary — check Instagram. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 14 July 2020 (Tabelog) as the street-facing café and lounge of the 2254 whole-building rental hotel in Miyagawa-cho. Reviewers from 2020 to 2026 describe a stylish, quiet room, staff who explain how grind changes a coffee, dog-loving staff, and a friendly exchange of recommendations with the restaurant opposite.

anecdotes.text: March 2024: the chef at the restaurant across the street recommended it, and "they mentioned that they often recommend Suiren when asked for delicious dining spots—it's a mutual" exchange.
June 2026: "Although I was not staying overnight, the café provided a very comfortable atmosphere."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 2254 ラウンジ、カフェ・ケーキ、東山区宮川筋2-254、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩約4分、火〜日 10:00〜20:00、月曜と不定休、時間は変動 (Instagram で確認)、予約不可、14席、テラス、禁煙 (入口付近のみ喫煙可)、ペット可 (リード付き、大きさ制限なし、ペットフードは持参)、英語メニュー、子供・ベビーカー可、車椅子可、カード・交通系IC・電子マネー・PayPay可、2020年7月14日オープン、一棟貸しホテルのラウンジを兼ねる宮川町のカフェバー。口コミ (2020年8月〜2026年6月、英語): クラフトビール、コーヒー、オーガニックスムージー、深煎りの Uma-machi ブレンド、アイスコーヒー600円、アイスカフェラテ650円、塩とこしょうのチーズケーキ、ナポリタン、犬好きのスタッフ、向かいの料理店と互いに紹介しあう。

kyoto_izumiya_chirimen_sansho.gf_detail: Ask: chirimen sansho is baby sardines simmered with sansho, usually in soy sauce — check the label (2013–2026 reviews).
kyoto_izumiya_chirimen_sansho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dried baby sardines (2012–2026 reviews).
kyoto_izumiya_chirimen_sansho.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 9:30–16:00. A take-away shop for chirimen sansho, with a counter for tasting (2012–2018 reviews); no eating space described. Cards and QR; no e-money. On Shindo-dori below Donguri, a back street between Gion and Kiyomizu; there was also a Ninenzaka shop (January 2013) and department-store sales (2013; October 2024).
kyoto_izumiya_chirimen_sansho.notes: [Chirimen sansho · Higashiyama back street, a soft, mild Kyoto souvenir] A small back-street shop between Gion and Kiyomizu selling its own chirimen sansho — soft baby sardines with gentle sansho, mild enough for children — with tastings at the counter; a repeat buyer calls it the essential Kyoto souvenir (August 2026). Take-away only; open daily 9:30–16:00.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2012 to 2026 describe a chirimen-sansho maker sold in department stores, with a quiet back-street shop on Shindo-dori offering face-to-face tastings and, in 2013, a second shop at the top of Ninenzaka; its chirimen is softer and its sansho milder than many rivals (2018; 2024).

anecdotes.text: October 2018: a review "mentioned that the chirimen had a soft texture, with the sansho being mild and not too spicy. This made me think it might be suitable for our family."
August 2026: "Izumiya is my favorite shop, and I've been here more than five times."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: いづみ屋、惣菜・デリ、東山区新道通団栗下ル上柳町196、祇園四条から215m、毎日 9:30〜16:00、予約可、禁煙、カード・QR可、電子マネー不可、サイト ojako.com。口コミ (2012年1月〜2026年8月、英語): ちりめん山椒の店、全国の百貨店でも販売、二年坂の上の店 (2013年)、新道通の本店で試食、やわらかくマイルドな山椒で子供にも、山椒茶漬け、かつおれんこん、徳用袋、京都のお土産の定番。

cultural_comfort.note: Take-away shop; tasting at the counter.

kyoto_yakiniku_riki_ayanokoji.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tare-marinated yakiniku, bibim noodles, cold noodles and bibimbap (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_riki_ayanokoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef yakiniku and offal house (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_riki_ayanokoji.hours_raw: Tabelog: Wed–Sun 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Monday and Tuesday. Reservations taken; 90-minute limit when busy; seat requests not guaranteed. 10% service charge in the fully private rooms (for 5 or more) — Tabelog, Japanese original 「完全個室サービス料10%(5名様以上からご利用可)」. 70 seats with a counter and private rooms for 2–8. Non-smoking with a smoking room. Cards, transit IC and e-money; no QR. On Ayanokoji west of Fuyacho. Opened 18 March 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_yakiniku_riki_ayanokoji.notes: [Yakiniku · Ayanokoji near Nishiki, good-value local grill] A spacious, clean yakiniku near the Shijo shops that locals rate for fair prices: salted tongue, outside skirt, kalbi and offal in half portions, yukhoe, the house oxtail soup and spicy bibim noodles to finish, with private rooms upstairs. 10% service in the private rooms. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 18 March 2022 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a clean, spacious room with private rooms on the second floor, friendly staff, quick service on weekdays, regulars and families, and prices they call among the more affordable in Kyoto.

anecdotes.text: July 2026: half portions of sashimi, tongue, liver and omasum, then "a soup with both seaweed and egg (it's JPY 500 for one type, but only an extra JPY 50 for two types…)."
October 2026, a regular: "I always order the Bibim Noodles. They have a nice spicy kick that doesn't linger."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉力、焼肉・ホルモン・居酒屋、下京区綾小路通麩屋町西入塩屋町79、阪急烏丸駅・四条駅から徒歩7分、水〜日 17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、月・火休み、予約可、混雑時90分制、原文で「完全個室サービス料10%(5名様以上からご利用可)」、70席、個室 (2〜8名)、禁煙 (喫煙室あり)、カード・交通系IC・電子マネー可、QR不可、2022年3月18日オープン。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 塩タン、リブロース、ハラミ、上カルビ、ロース、九条ねぎ塩、レバー、センマイ、ハーフサイズ、ユッケ、キムチのにんにくホイル焼き、名物のテールスープ、コムタン、わかめと卵のスープ (1種500円・2種550円)、石焼ビビンバ、冷麺、ビビン麺、清潔で広い、手頃な値段、2階の個室。

cultural_comfort.note: Local yakiniku; 10% service in private rooms.

kyoto_yokobayashi_gion.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: soy-grilled dishes, chawanmushi and dashi-based kappo cooking (2017–2025 reviews).
kyoto_yokobayashi_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, hamo, crab, fugu, suppon maru-nabe (Tabelog; 2017–2025 reviews).
kyoto_yokobayashi_gion.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday and 31 December–5 January. Reservations taken; private hire for 12–13. No cover charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「なし」. 15 seats: a 7-seat counter and two sunken-kotatsu tables for 4. Non-smoking. Cards (Visa, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money; no QR. Just south of Shijo off Yamato-oji, 2 min from Gion-Shijo Stn. Opened 20 September 1988 (Tabelog).
kyoto_yokobayashi_gion.notes: [Kappo · Gion south of Shijo, seasonal fish since 1988] A 15-seat kappo counter just south of Shijo, run since 1988 by a friendly owner-chef: seasonal sashimi, hamo in summer, matsutake in autumn, crab and fugu in winter, omakase or à la carte, finishing with a suppon maru-nabe. Fair prices for Gion, say reviewers. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner-chef, not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Opened 20 September 1988 (Tabelog); per its Tabelog text, more than 34 years of kappo cooking that suggests the best way to enjoy each ingredient. Reviewers from 2017 to 2025 describe a friendly, experimenting chef who recommends sashimi without dipping sauce, care over tableware, and a cosy counter and tatami room.
chef_bio.philosophy: From its Tabelog text: high-quality ingredients, served in the way that brings out their flavour.

anecdotes.text: March 2017: "The chef recommended that I enjoy the mixed sashimi without any dipping sauce."
May 2024: "You must try the finishing Maru Nabe; it's a must! (laughs)"

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: よこ林、日本料理・魚介料理、東山区大和大路四条下ル一筋目西入大和町15、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩2分、月〜土 17:00〜22:00、日曜休み、12月31日〜1月5日休み、予約可 (12〜13名で貸切可)、原文でチャージ「なし」、15席 (カウンター7、掘りごたつ4名×2)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー可、QR不可、1988年9月20日オープン、春は筍、夏は鱧、秋は松茸、冬は蟹やふぐ。口コミ (2017年3月〜2025年8月、英語・日本語): 創業29年 (2017年)、おまかせと単品、飯蛸、ふきのとう、鳥貝、刺身はつけ醤油なしで、鱧の落としと焼霜、鱧鍋、若竹煮、醤油焼き、ぶりしゃぶ、鮎、蟹、銀杏の醤油漬け、大きな茶碗蒸し、締めの丸鍋、気さくな大将、器にもこだわる、値段は手頃。

cultural_comfort.note: Small kappo counter; book.

kyoto_bubble_tea_berries.gf_detail: Ask. Tapioca drinks alongside crêpes and waffles made to order; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_bubble_tea_berries.vegan_detail: Not vegan: milk teas, whipped cream, custard and ice cream (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_bubble_tea_berries.hours_raw: 11:00–23:00 daily; closing days follow KYOTO TOWER SANDO (Tabelog). No reservations. AMEX card, e-money and QR (Tabelog). A counter stall with 8 seats, plus the food hall seating; drinks and crêpes are made to order, so expect a short wait (April and August 2025). In the Kyoto Tower Sando B1F food hall, 3 min walk from Kyoto Station (Tabelog; March 2026).
kyoto_bubble_tea_berries.notes: [Bubble tea and crêpes · Kyoto Tower Sando food hall] A small stall in the food hall under Kyoto Tower, one of the few non-drinking stops down there: tapioca drinks with domestic pearls and homemade Assam milk tea or Kyoto matcha, plus chewy crêpes heaped with fruit and cream (about ¥700). Made to order, so allow a few minutes. Open daily 11:00–23:00.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s introduction: a dessert shop focused on handmade, freshly made treats, using domestic tapioca and Kyoto matcha from a long-established shop said to date from the Heian period; homemade Assam milk tea; crêpes and waffles.
chef_bio.specialty: Homemade milk tea with tapioca; crêpes.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 visitor looking for a drink among the food-focused stalls of the food hall found this tapioca shop.
An August 2025 diner found the tapioca açaí bowl had melted to lukewarm by the time it was served.
An April 2025 parent reported a daughter wanting to work there after meeting the friendly staff.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: タピオカベリーズ、カフェ・タピオカ、下京区烏丸通七条下ル東塩小路町721-1 KYOTO TOWER SANDO、京都駅から259m、毎日 11:00〜23:00、休みはKYOTO TOWER SANDOに準ずる、予約不可、カード (AMEX)・電子マネー・QR可、8席。公式紹介: 国産タピオカと平安時代創業の老舗の京都抹茶、手作り・焼きたてのデザート専門店、ブラック・カラフル・チョコのタピオカ、アッサム茶葉から淹れる自家製ミルクティー、クレープとワッフル。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): バナナいちごクリーム660円、ダブルベリーいちご700円、チョコアーモンドクリーム、いちごチョコバナナ、タピオカアサイーボウル、スパークリングオレンジのタピオカ、注文後に作る、京都タワー地下のフードホール。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; food-hall seating.

kyoto_sake_to_koori_banks.gf_detail: Ask. Savoury and sweet shaved ice with toppings such as pie crust, stew and miso panna cotta; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_sake_to_koori_banks.vegan_detail: Ask. Most bowls use meat, bacon, cheese or cream, but a May 2026 reviewer says the staff may make bacon-free or meat-free versions on request (reviews).
kyoto_sake_to_koori_banks.hours_raw: 12:30–19:00 (last order 18:30), Wednesday–Sunday; closed Monday and Tuesday per Tabelog — but a May 2026 reviewer came on a weekday at about 20:00, so check the day’s hours and menu on Instagram @banks_kyoto (Tabelog; May 2026). Bookings via Instagram (August 2025). Cards, e-money and some QR (Tabelog). 16 seats: about 8 at the counter and a table for 4, a terrace; non-smoking; English menu; dog-friendly (Tabelog; August 2024; July 2026). Often one person working, so bowls take time (May 2026). Also offers lodging (January 2025; May 2026). In a renovated townhouse on Ikkanmachi-dori just off Gojo, 7 min walk from Shijo-Omiya and Tambaguchi Stns (Tabelog; July 2026).
kyoto_sake_to_koori_banks.notes: [Kakigori bar · Gojo-Omiya, savoury shaved ice] A chic townhouse bar near Gojo-Omiya shaving ice into unexpected savoury bowls — nikujaga over miso panna cotta, peach with cheese and grilled bacon, cream stew — alongside sweeter citrus-and-sansho or custard-strawberry ice, about ¥1,300–1,600, with cocktails. The daily menu is on Instagram; book there too. Dog-friendly.

roles: Owner not named; also runs a Japanese restaurant in Tokyo (January 2023 review)
chef_bio.background: Per a February 2023 reviewer, it was a café-bar serving curry, pasta and desserts that switched to kakigori during the pandemic closure; a January 2023 reviewer says the owner, who runs a Japanese restaurant in Tokyo, created the savoury kakigori from that experience. Reviewers (2025–2026) note it also offers lodging. Tabelog’s introduction: kakigori in a Kyoto townhouse — savoury ice, alcohol ice and seasonal fruit ice — with the day’s menu on Instagram.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 visitor looking for kakigori at 20:00 on a weekday found it here and watched a large block shaved by hand.
A February 2026 diner found mashed potato and apple mousse hidden inside the cream-stew ice.
A January 2025 lodging guest expected a basic soft-serve parfait and got a pretty, delicious one.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 酒とこおり ばんくす、かき氷・カフェ・バー、下京区下長福寺町276 1F、四条大宮駅・丹波口駅から徒歩7分、水〜日 12:30〜19:00 (L.O. 18:30)、月火定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、16席、テラス、禁煙、英語メニュー、子ども可。公式紹介: 京町家でかき氷、おかず氷・お酒の氷・季節の果物の氷、その日のメニューはInstagram。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 肉じゃが1,400円、肉じゃがミートパイ1,300円 (白味噌のパンナコッタ)、桃とチーズと焼きベーコン1,600円、チリトマト、クリームシチュー、さつまいもとみたらし、みかんとあんこクリーム、焼きカスタードいちご、柑橘と山椒とマスカルポーネ、トマトいちごベーコン、パフェ、焼酎とカクテル、元はカレーやパスタのカフェバー、東京で和食店を営む店主、宿泊も、犬連れ可、一貫町通、ひとりで切り盛りの日も、平日夜8時ごろに訪れた口コミ。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; book via Instagram.

kyoto_omoya_higashinotoin.gf_detail: Ask. Creative French courses mixing Japanese ingredients — fish with sauces, wagyu, desserts; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_omoya_higashinotoin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish and wagyu courses (reviews).
kyoto_omoya_higashinotoin.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30 to last order 14:30; dinner 17:30 to last order 20:30; closed Tuesday and the 2nd and 4th Wednesday; holiday hours vary — see the official site (Tabelog). Bookings accepted. No service charge (Tabelog original text: なし). Cards, transport IC, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 67 seats: tables and sunken seats on the ground floor, tables upstairs, a storehouse private room for 5–9 and a tea room; shoes off (Tabelog; July 2026). Through the back of SECOND HOUSE 東洞院店, on Higashinotoin south of Rokkaku, 7 min walk from Shijo-Karasuma (Tabelog).
kyoto_omoya_higashinotoin.notes: [Creative French · Higashinotoin near Shijo-Karasuma, a 1905 townhouse] Behind the SECOND HOUSE café, a long, quiet townhouse with a stone path, tatami, a storehouse room and a tea room, serving creative French courses with Japanese touches — sea bream with green-pea sauce, wagyu, pretty desserts — for about ¥4,000–6,500 at lunch, more at dinner. Shoes off; staff explain each dish. Closed Tuesday and the 2nd and 4th Wednesday.

roles: Chef not named; run by 株式会社ザックエンタープライズ (representative 足達 光男)
chef_bio.background: Per the operator’s site: 株式会社ザックエンタープライズ began in Kyoto in 1977 (company formed 1982) and runs spaghetti & cake SECOND HOUSE (main brand since 1980), the Kyoto-townhouse creative French restaurant o・mo・ya and others; about 70 staff and 250 part-timers. Tabelog’s introduction: a 1905 Kyoto townhouse at Shijo-Karasuma blending Japanese and Western flavours at reasonable prices, courses at lunch and dinner. A September 2026 reviewer has come about five times in 20 years.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator’s site: handmade, warm cooking in relaxed spaces, every dish and shop made by hand.
chef_bio.specialty: Creative French courses in a townhouse.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 wedding party was impressed by the seating plan and thoughtfully prepared dishes.
An August 2026 lunch guest found the "light" course not light at all.
A September 2026 mother and child cooled down on the water-sprinkled stone entrance before a generous starter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 運営会社サイト (secondhouse.co.jp): 株式会社ザックエンタープライズ、京都で1977年創業、町家フレンチのo・mo・yaやspaghetti & cake SECOND HOUSEを展開、1980年創業のメインブランド (約40種のスパゲッティ)、手作りのあたたかみある料理、代表取締役 足達 光男、社員70名・アルバイト250名。食べログ: フレンチ・ビストロ・日本料理、中京区東洞院六角下ル御射山町283、四条烏丸から徒歩7分、セカンドハウス東洞院店の奥へ、月・水〜日・祝 ランチ11:30〜14:30 (L.O.)、ディナー17:30〜20:30 (L.O.)、火曜と第2・第4水曜定休、サービス料なし、カード・電子マネー・QR可、67席 (1階テーブル26・掘りごたつ8、2階テーブル24、蔵の個室9、茶室)、インボイス T4130001006467。公式紹介: 1905年築の京町家、和と洋が融合した創作フレンチを手頃に、昼も夜もコース。口コミ (2026年、英語): 和牛のコース6,500円、ライトコース、鯛のポワレとグリーンピースのソース、いちごのデザート、夏野菜、料理の説明、箸、靴を脱ぐ、石畳の打ち水、20年で5回ほど。

Tables are limited to an hour (official site). No reservations. Cards, transport IC, iD, QUICPay and QR (Tabelog). 12 counter seats; non-smoking; English menu; takeout (Tabelog). kyoto_siam_thai_curry.notes: [Thai curry · Enmachi, a long-loved specialist] A 12-seat counter near Enmachi Station grinding its own pastes from fresh Thai herbs: bright green curry, red, and a peanutty "Islam" (massaman) curry, built your way with fillings, toppings and rice by the gram. A lunch set with salad is about ¥1,100. It sells out some days; closed Wednesday. Sister of タイカレーラーメン シャム.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Kyoto’s first Thai-curry specialist, recognised in Thailand, with homemade curry pastes ground from fresh Thai herbs and made weekly to keep the aroma; it later opened the sister shop タイカレーラーメン専門店シャム (kyoto_thai_curry_ramen_siam in data); press in Amakara Techo, Mapple and Tabelog Best Restaurant 2009–2010. Reviewers (2025–2026) say it is Thai Select certified, and a September 2026 reviewer heard of a temporary closure to relocate in 2027.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: an authentic taste that Thailand recognises — refreshing heat, mellow coconut milk, fruity sweetness and spice.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor walked 30 minutes from Hankyu Nishin Station only to find the curry sold out.
A November 2025 diner came back after more than ten years, following a stay in a nearby hospital, for the red chicken curry.
An October 2026 regular of over ten years still calls the green curry exquisite.

A January 2026 yoshoku lover noted the retro room's scattered Hanshin Tigers goods.
A neighbour working from home over Obon 2026 walked over at 11:40 rather than cook, and was warned upstairs that food would take a while.

In September 2026 the same regular marked matsutake season with dobin-mushi, kizushi and hamo ginkgo rice.

kyoto_jazz_in_rokudenashi.notes: [Jazz kissa & bar · Kiyamachi] A worn, record-lined jazz room up a stair on Kiyamachi, open from mid-afternoon to 2:00: coffee or kombu tea for about ¥500 by day, rum or umeshu soda by night, vintage amps and requests from the owner's collection. kyoto_taishitei_kiyamachi.notes: [Yakiniku · Kiyamachi] A late-opening yakiniku in a small alley off Kiyamachi, open till 1:00: Kobe and kuroge wagyu, salted tongue and a broad offal list, with frosted-mug draft beer and a party floor upstairs. About ¥3,000–5,000. Smoking allowed; closed Monday.

chef_bio.philosophy: Kobe beef and kuroge wagyu, with beef raised from the pasture up, paired with wine and sake (TableCheck).

anecdotes.text: On the last night of a January 2026 trip, a diner came for horumon after yakitori and a course meal, and ordered salted tongue, an offal platter and ume kimchi.
A June 2026 visitor with two smoker friends was glad smoking is allowed, and was steered to the garlic ponzu.

kyoto_7t_plus_tea.gf_detail: Ask. Teas, oat-milk lattes and tea gelato; straight teas contain no wheat, but nothing is labelled gluten-free (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_7t_plus_tea.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: the lattes are made only with oat milk, sweetened with agave syrup if you like (May, June and August 2026), and the straight teas are plant-based; the tea gelato is not described.
kyoto_7t_plus_tea.hours_raw: 11:00–19:00 daily; hours may change (official site; Tabelog). No cards; e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). Tea leaves for sale with tasting before you buy; staff help you choose (2025–2026 reviews). Takeaway drinks (August 2026). On Ayanokoji east of Tominokoji, near Nishiki Market (Tabelog; May 2026).
kyoto_7t_plus_tea.notes: [Tea stand · near Nishiki Market, 70 teas and oat-milk matcha] A lab-like tea shop where staff help you smell and taste your way through over seventy teas — Japanese, Chinese and Taiwanese — and make matcha lattes from your chosen leaf with oat milk only, plus tea gelato. Leaves to take home; no cards.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe knowledgeable, friendly staff who suggest teas and brew samples (March and November 2025, May 2026), and a shop laid out like a laboratory with petri dishes of tea leaves (November 2025, September 2026).

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 visitor came in for gelato, forgot about it among the dishes of tea leaves, and was matched to a tea with remarkable precision.
A March 2026 guest was struck by a grape-leaf tea from a winery among the world teas.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 7T＋ (セブンティープラス)、下京区塩屋町73-1、11:00〜19:00、茶葉の販売 (碁石茶980円、焙煎ばん茶700円、蒙頂黄芽、杉林渓高山烏龍茶、和紅茶べにふうき、朝宮おくみどりの抹茶など)、ジェラート。食べログ: カフェ、綾小路富小路東入、電子マネー・QR決済可、カード不可。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 発酵度で7つに分けた70種以上の茶葉・ハーブ・ドライフルーツ、試飲して選べる、詳しく親切な店員、茶葉を選べる抹茶ラテはオーツミルクのみ (アガベシロップ)、和烏龍のアイスティー、阿波晩茶や焙煎ばん茶のジェラート、実験室のような店内。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff help you smell and taste teas before choosing; no cards.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_impulse_kissa.gf_detail: Ask. Siphon coffee, café au lait, coffee float and ice cream; no food or gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_impulse_kissa.vegan_detail: Ask. Black siphon coffee is plant-based; the lattes come topped with whipped cream (February and March 2026).
kyoto_impulse_kissa.hours_raw: Monday–Wednesday and Friday–Sunday 9:00–21:00; closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; February 2026). Smoking allowed at every seat — reviewers stress this (November 2025; February, March and August 2026). Menu set into the tables (August 2026). On Kawaramachi-dori north of Takoyakushi, about 10 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi or Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog).
kyoto_impulse_kissa.notes: [Kissaten · Kawaramachi-dori, siphon coffee and smoking] A deep, retro coffee house on Kawaramachi with jazz playing and menus under the table glass, brewing each cup by siphon — blends, single origins, whipped-cream lattes and floats. One of the few cafés left where every seat allows smoking; cash only; closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a retro, jazz-filled coffee house with a deep room and a striking storefront and sign (August 2026), and note that it is one of the few remaining cafés where smoking is allowed throughout (2025–2026).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 passer-by was drawn in by the lettering of the sign and ordered an unusual Java coffee.
A December 2025 pair stopped in after a Chinese lunch for an iced coffee and a Guatemala on an unseasonably warm day.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: インパルス、喫茶店・カフェ、中京区河原町通蛸薬師上ル奈良屋町292、京阪三条駅・阪急河原町駅から徒歩10分、月〜水・金〜日 9:00〜21:00、木曜定休、現金のみ。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): すべてサイフォンで淹れるコーヒー、ストロングブレンド、グアテマラ、ジャワ、ホイップをのせたカフェオレ800円とカフェラテ750円、コーヒーフロート950円ほど、濃いアイスクリーム、全席喫煙可、ジャズ、テーブルに埋め込んだメニュー、レトロな店内。

cultural_comfort.note: Smoking at every seat; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_obanzai_grill_sala.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai, sashimi, grilled chicken, chawanmushi and rice (2025–26 reviews); tell the restaurant about allergies when booking (Tabelog). No gluten information.
kyoto_obanzai_grill_sala.vegan_detail: Not vegan: grilled chicken and fish mains with dashi-based obanzai (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_obanzai_grill_sala.hours_raw: Tue–Sun and holidays: lunch 11:00–14:00 (last order 13:45), dinner 18:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, advised at weekends; 90-minute limit when busy; tell the restaurant about allergies and children (Tabelog; February 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR incl. PayPay (Tabelog). 30 seats: a counter of 8, tables and a private room for 8 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Order by QR code at the table (February 2026). Second floor, 2 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi exit 10 (Tabelog). Opened 15 September 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_obanzai_grill_sala.notes: [Obanzai and grill · Shijo Kawaramachi, a second-floor dining room] A stylish second-floor room with a kitchen counter, best at lunch: a drawer-box of six obanzai, a hanging skewer of charcoal-grilled Tanba chicken or fish, make-your-own yuba, refills of rice and miso soup — from about ¥2,000. Teppanyaki wagyu at night. Closed Monday; book at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a teppanyaki wagyu and obanzai restaurant with counter, table and private-room seating, opened in September 2022.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 lunch guest pulled out the drawer of the obanzai box to find six small dishes inside.
A May 2026 regular found the mains cut back to chicken or tofu since a visit two years earlier, and the air conditioning too strong in a private room.
An April 2026 day-tripper liked making yuba at the table and trying it with salt, ponzu, sesame sauce and olive oil.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ステーキ・鉄板焼き・ダイニングバー、下京区足袋屋町329 キョウテクあやごっこビル 2F、阪急京都河原町駅10番出口から徒歩約2分、火〜日・祝11:00〜14:00 (L.O. 13:45)、18:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、月曜休み、予約可、混雑時は90分、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、30席 (カウンター8、テーブル、個室)、禁煙、2022年9月15日オープン、和牛の鉄板焼きと季節のおばんざい。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年9月、英語): 引き出しのおばんざい6種と主菜を選べる SALA 御膳、ご飯と味噌汁のおかわり、2,800円の限定ランチ、まぐろの刺身、Tanba の鶏の炭火焼き、茶碗蒸し、湯葉を作る、白ワイン750円。

cultural_comfort.note: Book lunch at weekends; order by QR code at the table. No English evidence found.

kyoto_ichiyoken_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Drinks only since the end of 2025 (April 2026 review); no gluten information.
kyoto_ichiyoken_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Drinks only since the end of 2025 (April 2026 review).
kyoto_ichiyoken_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun from 17:30 to about 22:00; closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). Drinks only: the chef stopped serving food at the end of 2025 (April 2026 review). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). A polished counter (Tabelog; April 2016). Deep in a narrow, winding alley between Kiyamachi and Pontocho at Nabeya-cho, north of Shijo (2016–19 reviews).
kyoto_ichiyoken_kiyamachi.notes: [Retro Western bar · Kiyamachi alley, since 1922] A sepia-toned Western-style bar founded in 1922, hidden at the end of a twisting alley between Kiyamachi and Pontocho, with a polished counter and shelves of Nikka whisky. The kitchen — once known for shrimp coquille and oyster fry — closed at the end of 2025, so it now serves drinks only. Closed Thursday.

roles: Chef (unnamed), long-serving; stopped cooking at the end of 2025 (April 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: A February 2017 review says the restaurant was founded in 1922; reviews from 2010 to 2019 describe regulars of 15 to over 20 years. An April 2026 review reports that the chef stopped serving food at the end of 2025 and that only drinks are now served.
chef_bio.specialty: Whisky and cocktails in a 1920s setting.

anecdotes.text: A regular since 1994 marked the arrival of winter by the oyster fry, served from mid-November to mid-March (December 2010).
An April 2016 couple found it after cherry-blossom viewing, deep in an alley you would not find without knowing it.
An April 2026 visitor reported that food has ended and drinks remain.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洋食、中京区木屋町通四条上ル鍋屋町211、17:30〜22:00頃、木曜休み、予約可、カウンター。口コミ (2010年12月〜2026年4月、英語): 1922年創業、木屋町と先斗町の間の細い路地の奥、レトロな洋食のバー、磨かれたカウンター、Nikka のウイスキー、かつてはエビのコキール、冬のカキフライ、チキンカツ、ビーフカツ、エビのクリームコロッケ、2025年末で料理をやめ、今は飲み物のみ (2026年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Hard to find — look for the alley off Kiyamachi at Nabeya-cho; drinks only now. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; an April 2026 review confirms it is open, serving drinks only.

kyoto_sasora_east_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Set meals of grilled fish and tamagoyaki, salads, chicken, pizza and cake (2023–26 reviews); pizza and cake contain wheat; no gluten information.
kyoto_sasora_east_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: mackerel set meal, chicken, pizza (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sasora_east_pontocho.hours_raw: Daily: café 12:00–17:00, bar and dinner 17:00–22:30 (last order 21:45) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Charge ¥500 at dinner on the first floor (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「ディナー １F 500円」). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and transport IC cards; no QR (Tabelog). 30 seats: 20 on the first floor (counter with a river view, tables, sofas) and 10 upstairs (Tabelog; January 2025). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Pets allowed on the riverside deck (August 2023). A renovated former tea house on Pontocho, 3 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi (Tabelog; May 2025).
kyoto_sasora_east_pontocho.notes: [Café-bar · Pontocho, a tea house on the Kamo river] A renovated former tea house on Pontocho opening onto a riverside terrace: a café with cake sets and a simple mackerel lunch by day, and a bar for drinks with a river view, salads and pizza at night. ¥500 charge at dinner; smoking allowed. Dogs welcome on the deck.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a stylish space renovated from an old tea house, with a café and bar and a riverside terrace on the first floor and teppanyaki on the second; one of three Sasora listings in Pontocho.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 lunch guest, wary of Pontocho prices, found the mackerel set meal good value.
An August 2026 pair booked the 18:00 river-edge seats on a cloudy evening and found the portions too big to order more.
A May 2025 visitor had hoped to sit closer to the water and found the terrace less cool than expected.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ・バー、中京区鍋屋町230-1 1F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、毎日12:00〜17:00と17:00〜22:30 (L.O. 21:45)、予約可、ディナー 1F 500円、カード・交通系 IC 可、30席 (1F 20席、2F 10席)、喫煙可、お茶屋を改装した空間、1F はカフェとバーと川沿いのテラス、2F は鉄板焼き、ランチ2,000円から。口コミ (2023年1月〜2026年8月、英語): 鴨川を望むカウンター、鯖の定食と卵焼き、サラダ、鶏のわさびソース、ビスマルクのピザ、ケーキのセット、ウイスキー、ペットはデッキで可。

cultural_comfort.note: Ask for the riverside terrace or the river-view counter; ¥500 charge at dinner; smoking allowed. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_kuroge_wagyu_zen_kawaramachi.gf_detail: Ask. Wagyu yakiniku with about six sauces, sukiyaki and shabu-shabu, plus cold noodles and bibimbap (2025–26 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_kuroge_wagyu_zen_kawaramachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku, sukiyaki and shabu-shabu restaurant (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kuroge_wagyu_zen_kawaramachi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:00–1:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–1:00 (last order 0:00); closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards incl. UnionPay; e-money; QR incl. PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 100 seats, all in semi-private or private rooms; tablet ordering (Tabelog; December 2025; October 2026). Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). Furushiro Building 6F, on Kawaramachi south of Takoyakushi, 5 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi (Tabelog).
kyoto_kuroge_wagyu_zen_kawaramachi.notes: [Wagyu all-you-can-eat · Kawaramachi, private rooms] A 100-seat sixth-floor restaurant where every table is in a private or semi-private room: black wagyu as yakiniku, sukiyaki or shabu-shabu, mostly as all-you-can-eat courses from about ¥3,800 at lunch to ¥8,250 for A5, ordered by tablet. Open to 1:00. Reviews are mixed on service and on tougher cuts.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the Kyoto Shijo Kawaramachi branch of Kuroge Wagyu Zen (the other is in Namba Shinsaibashi), serving A4-or-higher black wagyu as yakiniku, sukiyaki and shabu-shabu.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner chose the shabu-shabu course and found the private rooms and tablet ordering suited business meetings and dates.
A September 2026 diner had the ¥8,250 A5 course and liked trying about six sauces.
An October 2026 diner found the meat tough and the all-you-can-drink weak.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉・すき焼き・しゃぶしゃぶ、中京区河原町通蛸薬師下ル塩屋町324 古城ビル 6F、阪急京都河原町駅3番出口から徒歩約5分、月〜金17:00〜翌1:00、土日祝11:30〜翌1:00 (L.O. 0:00)、不定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、100席 (半個室と完全個室)、禁煙、車椅子可、A4以上の黒毛和牛を焼肉、すき焼き、しゃぶしゃぶで、食べ放題4,180円から。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年10月、英語): 昼の食べ放題3,800円、飲み放題2時間2,000円、A5の食べ放題8,250円、たれ6種、しゃぶしゃぶのコース、冷麺、ビビンバ、タブレットで注文、肉が硬い、提供が遅いとの声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Order by tablet in a private room; all-you-can-eat courses are the norm. No English evidence found.
